VYGO_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Basic settings for the Slay the Spire 2 YuGiOh MasterDuel Mod.
VYGO_SETTINGS_EFFECT_ANIMATION_DESCRIPTI: Full animation plays all summon effects. Quick animation keeps only the material flashes and the summoned card flying out. No animation skips all summon effects.
VYGO_SETTINGS_PLACEHOLDER_NOTICE_DESCRIP: The following options are placeholders and currently do not affect gameplay.
VYGO_SETTINGS_PLACEHOLDER_TOGGLE_DESCRIP: A placeholder toggle with no effect yet.
VYGO_SETTINGS_PLACEHOLDER_VALUE_DESCRIPT: A placeholder integer setting with no effect yet.
VYGO_SETTINGS_REPLACE_MAIN_MENU_DESCRIPT: Use the VYgo main menu appearance and background music. Requires a game restart to take effect.
VYGO_SETTINGS_REPLACE_UI_SKIN_DESCRIPTIO: Apply configured appearances to common buttons, panels, and other UI components. Independent of the main menu replacement. Requires a game restart.
